functional_requirements.title: Patient Personal Details Input
functional_requirements.quote: Create a form that allows patients to input their personal details, including: First Name, Middle Name (optional), Last Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Phone Number, Email, Address, Preferred Language, Nationality, Emergency Contact (optional: name and relationship), Religion (optional).
functional_requirements.explanation: Patient form must collect patient details with specific required and optional fields.

functional_requirements.title: Patient Form Validation
functional_requirements.quote: Include form validation (e.g., required fields, valid phone number, email if applicable).
functional_requirements.explanation: Form inputs must be validated before submission/during input, ensuring required fields are populated and phone/email formats are valid.

functional_requirements.title: Staff View Real-Time Field Display
functional_requirements.quote: Display each field from the patient form in real-time as the patient inputs or updates information.
functional_requirements.explanation: Staff interface must render every field value in real time as changes occur on the patient form.

functional_requirements.title: Patient Activity Indicators on Staff View
functional_requirements.quote: Display indicators to show if the patient has submitted, is actively filling in, or is inactive in the form.
functional_requirements.explanation: Staff interface must show status indicators: Submitted, Actively Filling In, or Inactive.

functional_requirements.title: Real-Time Data Synchronization
functional_requirements.quote: Use WebSockets or any suitable real-time technology to synchronize data between the patient and staff views instantly.
functional_requirements.explanation: Instantly propagate input changes and state changes from patient form to staff view using real-time communication.

non_functional_requirements.title: Responsive Design for Patient Form
non_functional_requirements.quote: Responsive design that functions well on mobile and desktop devices.
non_functional_requirements.explanation: Patient form UI must adapt seamlessly across screen sizes.

non_functional_requirements.title: Responsive Design for Staff View
non_functional_requirements.quote: Provide a responsive design for staff members, adapting to various screen sizes.
non_functional_requirements.explanation: Staff view UI must adapt seamlessly across screen sizes.

non_functional_requirements.title: Instant Data Sync Latency
non_functional_requirements.quote: synchronize data between the patient and staff views instantly.
non_functional_requirements.explanation: Updates on patient form should reflect immediately on staff view without noticeable lag.

non_functional_requirements.title: Simple and Intuitive UX/UI
non_functional_requirements.quote: A simple, intuitive design that provides a smooth experience for both patient and staff users.
non_functional_requirements.explanation: Interfaces should be user-friendly and clean.

constraints.title: Timeline Constraint
constraints.quote: Each candidate must complete the assignment within 3 days of receiving the task.

constraints.title: Framework Constraint
constraints.explanation: Project must be built using Next.js framework.

constraints.title: Real-Time Communication Technology Constraint
constraints.quote: Real-Time Communication: WebSockets or any suitable solution
constraints.explanation: Must use WebSockets or compatible real-time technology.

constraints.title: Hosting Constraint
constraints.quote: Hosting: Deploy on a platform such as Vercel, Heroku, or Netlify.
constraints.explanation: Must be deployed to a frontend cloud hosting platform.

deliverables.title: Code Repository
deliverables.quote: Code Repository: Link to a GitHub (or similar) repository with clear instructions for running the project.
deliverables.explanation: Public or shared code repository with run instructions.

deliverables.title: Deployed Application
deliverables.quote: Deployed Application: Live link to the deployed project.
deliverables.explanation: Accessible live URL for the deployed web app.

deliverables.title: README File
deliverables.quote: Readme File: Include a README with an overview of the project, any setup instructions, and descriptions of any bonus features implemented.

deliverables.title: Development Planning Documentation
deliverables.quote: Development Planning documentation: Project Structure: Explanation of the folder/file structure. Design: design decisions made for UI/UX in different screen size. Component Architecture: Description of main components and their purposes. Real-Time Synchronization Flow: Summary of how real-time updates are handled and synchronized.
deliverables.explanation: Must include documentation covering Project Structure, UI/UX Design, Component Architecture, and Real-Time Synchronization Flow.

missing_information.topic: Session / Room Management for Patient-Staff Coupling
missing_information.description: The specification does not clarify whether single or multi-session (room IDs / patient IDs) synchronization is required, or if a single global sync pair is sufficient.
The requirement specifies an 'inactive in the form' status indicator, but does not define the explicit timeout duration (e.g., 5 seconds, 10 seconds, or 30 seconds of typing inactivity).
The prompt does not explicitly request database storage or persistence after submission.

bonus_features.title: Mock Data Generator
bonus_features.description: Provides a 1-click sample data filling button for quick evaluator testing.

bonus_features.title: Form Auto-Save & Local Backup
bonus_features.description: Persists incomplete patient input to localStorage and restores on page reload.

bonus_features.title: Audit Trail / History Log
bonus_features.description: Displays chronological stream of patient updates with timestamps on Staff View.

bonus_features.title: Field-Level Typing Indicator
bonus_features.description: Broadcasting focused field name so staff knows exactly which input is being edited.

bonus_features.title: Data Export (JSON & CSV)
bonus_features.description: Enables staff members to download patient form submissions in JSON or CSV format.
